summary: The session has started on the back foot: the Nifty was down about 0.8% at pre-open, a steeper drop than overnight cues suggested, while the Sensex was off a milder 0.4%.

detail.tone: Selling resumed from the bell instead of the flat start Gift Nifty pointed to earlier, with traders cutting risk before Friday's holiday.
